EFFECTIVE SAMPLE ASSESSMENT.explanation: Protocol pre-registration does not establish independence. Shared dates/years, markets, sectors, global shocks, long horizon overlap and prior full-path exposure must be retained.

caveats.description: DAX ^GDAXI is ordinarily a performance index with embedded dividend reinvestment. Provider source proof and distinct return_basis needed; do not describe all foreign indices as ex-dividend PRICE_ONLY or compare index variants as directly tradable total return.
SLOOS bank C&I loan-standards net-tightening is credit supply sentiment/terms, not direct credit spread, default/refinancing, solvency or complete crisis classifier.

Economically motivated interaction requires a predeclared single-variable sign gate; because tested gate and interaction share historical data, a surviving interaction is exploratory and conditional-on-selection, not independent confirmatory validation.
Calendar decades are cross-time labels, not observed rate/inflation/credit regimes. Missing historical releases must remain UNKNOWN; price-only panel cannot establish macro-state transferability.
All three local content hashes match; no external historical timestamp or cognitive blindness is claimed.
